fields.why: Both agree on outbreak investigation; the Summary headline compares mean annual deaths in 2009–2018 vs 2019–2022 (before/after or trend), while the Consular death records are a passive surveillance series (surveillance/descriptive). Either secondary value is defensible.

brief_issues: The brief does not say whether a period comparison of counts from a surveillance series inside an outbreak investigation adds before/after or trend, surveillance/descriptive, or nothing beyond outbreak investigation.
